name: 35022 · Bessemer, AL
findings: ZIP 35022 (Bessemer) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35022 (Bessemer) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35022 (Bessemer) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
